meta.chapterLabel: Lesson 13: Asking for a Place: Where Is It?

items.note: この (this, from これ／この, Lesson 5) + ちかく (vicinity, near, Lesson 12) = "near here." Compare すぐそこ (right over there) in this lesson, which points to a specific spot rather than a general area.

Suffix attached after a noun to mean "...shop": ほんや (bookstore), パンや (bakery), ラーメンや (ramen shop); adding さん afterward, as in おそばやさん, softens the tone. This や is the same word behind そばや (soba shop, Lesson 12) and てんぷらや (Lesson 9) — a different word from the や (ya) particle meaning "and, and so on," also taught in Lesson 12.
items.reviewNote: Not given its own headword row; extracted from the recurring 〜や shop-suffix pattern across this lesson's vocabulary and NOTES 1's explicit discussion of 〜や denoting "shop". | Possibly already taught — already introduced in Lesson 9: Doing Things (2): Do You Often Come Here? (matched on target) | Excluded as a re-teach of chapter-9/ya-suffix (same や shop suffix), which already carries a disambiguating scene.

items.note: そばや (soba shop, already seen bare in Lesson 12) plus さん, which softens the tone (NOTES 1).
items.reviewNote: Possibly already taught — already introduced in Lesson 12: Asking about Places: What Is at Nikko? (matched on english)
items.hint: polite form, with お… and …さん

items.note: The ko-so-a location set, by DISTANCE FROM EACH SPEAKER (the chapter teaches this with a picture, not words): ここ is where the speaker is, そこ is near the listener, あそこ is away from BOTH of you.
items.reviewNote: Possibly already taught — already introduced in Lesson 5: Shopping (2): Two Bottles of That Wine, Please (matched on english)

items.note: Connects two separate sentences ("...です。それから、...") to add another fact about the same topic, unlike も (also, Lesson 4), which attaches directly onto a single noun within one sentence.

items.english: Tanaka-san is Japanese. He is also a student.
items.target: たなかさんはにほんじんです。それから、がくせいです
items.pronunciation: tanaka-san wa nihonjin desu. sorekara, gakusei desu
items.reviewNote: Example demonstrating それから as a connecting word — the chapter's own use of それから appears only inside the TARGET DIALOGUE, which is off-limits dialogue script, and no other section demonstrates it.

items.note: い-adjective meaning "near." Opposite of とおい (far, this lesson). Contrast the noun ちかく (vicinity, Lesson 12) — ちかい describes something as being close, while ちかく names the surrounding area.
Opposite of ちかい (near, this lesson).

items.english: The airport is far from the station.
items.target: くうこうはえきからとおいです
items.pronunciation: kūkō wa eki kara tōi desu
items.reviewNote: とおい otherwise appears only inside the off-limits TARGET DIALOGUE; this mirrors the ちかい pattern (place1は place2から ちかい／とおいです, GRAMMAR 3) with the opposite adjective.

items.note: のりば (noriba) is a suffix meaning "boarding place," attached after a vehicle name — also seen in バスのりば (bus terminal) and ボートのりば (boat dock), both this lesson.

items.english: There are six chairs in the meeting room.
items.target: かいぎしつにいすが６つあります
items.ttsText: かいぎしつにいすがむっつあります
items.pronunciation: kaigishitsu ni isu ga muttsu arimasu

items.english: There are four guests in the meeting room.
items.target: かいぎしつにおきゃくさんが４にんいます
items.ttsText: かいぎしつにおきゃくさんがよにんいます
items.pronunciation: kaigishitsu ni okyakusan ga yonin imasu

items.english: The taxi stand is in front of the station.
items.target: タクシーのりばはえきのまえです
items.pronunciation: takushī noriba wa eki no mae desu

items.english: Smith-san is on the second floor.
items.target: スミスさんは２かいにいます
items.ttsText: スミスさんはにかいにいます

items.english: Smith-san's house is near the station.
items.target: スミスさんのうちはえきからちかいです
items.pronunciation: sumisu-san no uchi wa eki kara chikai desu
items.note: Pattern: place1 は place2 から ちかい／とおいです — the point being compared from takes から, the same "from" particle used for direction (Lesson 6) and time (Lesson 3). This sentence is the model other cards, like としょかんはえきからちかいです, follow.

items.english: There is a restaurant on the first floor.
items.target: 1かいにレストランがあります
items.ttsText: いっかいにレストランがあります
items.note: Contrast with "The restaurant is on the first floor," which uses は because the restaurant is already the established topic (see GRAMMAR 2).

items.english: The restaurant is on the first floor.
items.target: レストランは1かいにあります
items.ttsText: レストランはいっかいにあります
items.hint: using に あります (not contracted)
items.note: The restaurant's existence is already known, so the topic marker は replaces が; contrast with the が あります version, which introduces the restaurant as new information. Compare also the shorter contracted version below using です.

items.english: The restaurant is on the first floor.
items.target: レストランは1かいです
items.ttsText: レストランはいっかいです
items.hint: contracted with です instead of に あります
items.note: A shortened version that replaces に あります with です once the restaurant's existence and location are already established; this contraction is not possible for the が あります existence statement (see GRAMMAR 2).
ほん (book) + や (shop suffix, see the や card) = ほんや.
Root word of パンや (bakery).
パン (bread, see that card) + や (shop suffix) = パンや.
ラーメン (ramen) + や (shop suffix).

items.note: The ko-so-a location set, by DISTANCE FROM EACH SPEAKER (the chapter teaches this with a picture, not words): ここ is where the speaker is, そこ is near the listener, あそこ is away from both. Pick by who is closest, not by how far away it feels.
items.reviewNote: No English gloss is given anywhere in this chapter's text (it appears only as a WORD POWER illustration caption); meaning inferred from the common ko-so-a demonstrative sense, paired with そこ ("there") and あそこ ("over there"), which ARE glossed elsewhere in this chapter. | Possibly already taught — already introduced in Lesson 9: Doing Things (2): Do You Often Come Here? (matched on english) | Excluded as a duplicate of chapter-9/koko-here, which teaches the same word with the same meaning and is the earlier occurrence.

items.note: The ko-so-a location set, by DISTANCE FROM EACH SPEAKER (the chapter teaches this with a picture, not words): ここ is where the speaker is, そこ is near the LISTENER, あそこ is away from both. そこ is not simply "there" — it specifically means near the person you are talking to.
Combines with おんなの (female) and おとこの (male) to form おんなの こ (girl) and おとこの こ (boy).
こ alone means "child" (see that card); おんなの こ = "girl" and おとこの こ = "boy".
こ alone means "child" (see that card); おとこの こ = "boy" and おんなの こ = "girl".

General "how many" question word, paired with the つ counter for general objects (Lesson 5: ひとつ, ふたつ...). Compare the specific counter questions なんぼん (long objects) and なんまい (flat objects), both this lesson, and なんにん (how many people, Lesson 8).

items.english: How many apples are there on the table?
items.target: テーブルのうえにりんごがいくつありますか
items.pronunciation: tēburu no ue ni ringo ga ikutsu arimasu ka

items.scene: answering how many apples are on the table

items.note: なん (what, Lesson 2) + ほん／ぼん (counter for long thin objects, Lesson 5) — the same なん + counter pattern as なんにん (how many people, Lesson 8) and なんまい (this lesson).

items.target: えんぴつがなんぼんありますか
items.reviewNote: Example demonstrating なんぼん — the chapter's own use appears only inside an unfilled EXERCISES blank.

items.note: なん (what, Lesson 2) + まい (counter for flat objects, Lesson 5) — the same なん + counter pattern as なんぼん (this lesson) and なんにん (how many people, Lesson 8).

items.english: How many clear files are there?
items.target: クリアファイルがなんまいありますか
items.pronunciation: kuria fairu ga nanmai arimasu ka
items.reviewNote: Example demonstrating なんまい — the chapter's own use appears only inside an unfilled EXERCISES blank.

items.note: はな (flower) + や (shop suffix, see the や card).
しゃちょう (company president, Lesson 9) + しつ (room suffix, as in かいぎしつ, Lesson 12) = "president's office."

items.english: The library is near the station.
items.target: としょかんはえきからちかいです
items.pronunciation: toshokan wa eki kara chikai desu
items.note: Same pattern as "Smith-san's house is near the station" (place1は place2から ちかい／とおいです, GRAMMAR 3) applied to a different noun.
バスてい (basutei) names a stop along a route, unlike バスのりば (bus terminal, this lesson), a dedicated boarding facility — two different words for two kinds of bus-related spots.
すぐ (right away, immediately) + そこ (there, part of the ここ／そこ／あそこ set) = "right over there," emphasizing how close it is.

items.english: There are five pens in the drawer.
items.target: ひきだしのなかにペンが5ほんあります
items.ttsText: ひきだしのなかにペンがごほんあります
items.pronunciation: hikidashi no naka ni pen ga gohon arimasu

items.note: Used for an approximate point in time (e.g. 3じごろ, "around 3 o'clock"); unlike ぐらい, it cannot be used for an approximate DURATION of time.

items.ttsText: かいぎはさんじごろです
items.reviewNote: Example demonstrating 〜ごろ — the chapter's own use appears only inside the SPEAKING PRACTICE dialogue script, which is off-limits for card extraction.

items.english: There are six business cards on the desk.
items.target: つくえのうえにめいしが6まいあります
items.pronunciation: tsukue no ue ni meishi ga roku-mai arimasu
items.ttsText: つくえのうえにめいしがろくまいあります

items.english: There are three paper clips in the drawer.
items.target: ひきだしのなかにクリップが3つあります
items.pronunciation: hikidashi no naka ni kurippu ga mit-tsu arimasu
items.ttsText: ひきだしのなかにクリップがみっつあります

items.english: There are three men in the park.
items.target: こうえんにおとこのひとが3にんいます
items.pronunciation: kōen ni otoko no hito ga san-nin imasu
items.ttsText: こうえんにおとこのひとがさんにんいます

items.english: How many forks are there on the table?
items.target: テーブルのうえにフォークがなんぼんありますか
items.pronunciation: tēburu no ue ni fōku ga nan-bon arimasu ka

items.scene: answering how many forks are on the table

items.english: The florist is next to the hospital.
items.target: はなやはびょういんのとなりにあります
items.pronunciation: hanaya wa byōin no tonari ni arimasu

items.english: The police box is over there.
items.target: こうばんはあそこにあります
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [noun] は [place] にあります. The source already teaches this simple existence-location frame (grammar2-2-restaurant-topic), and fib-hanaya-tonari-byouin covers the same frame with a more novel construction (のとなり), so this third, plainer example is redundant.

items.target: たなかさんはどこにいますか
items.pronunciation: Tanaka-san wa doko ni imasu ka

items.target: しゃちょうしつにいます
くまのじんじゃはここからちかいですか
items.pronunciation: Kumano-jinja wa koko kara chikai desu ka
